description: VYBE Music v5.0.1 - 8 New Official App Icons for all users, Founder & Co-Founder profiles, Admin controls privacy fix, and silent admin portal access.
changelog: 8 Official App Icons: Built-in 8 new vibrant icons (Lofi Sunset Monkey, Meow Beats Cat, Cloud Melody Pup, Holo Vinyl Disc, Midnight Anime Boy, Cosmic Pixel Saturn, Retro Glitch Cat, Halftone Cyber Cat) selectable by all users
Admin Controls Privacy: Admin Icon Controls upload panel is strictly hidden from regular users and reserved for verified administrators
Founder & Co-Founder Profiles: Added direct profile links for REDDY ABC (@bhanuchennareddy) and @saidharaneedharr-lang in the About screen
Live Contributors Sanitization: Contributors list dynamically synchronizes clean repository contributors while filtering legacy test names
Silent Admin Portal Access: Removed countdown toast message when tapping Organization 7 times
